description: Where a gross amount does more good - pension, ISA or Lifetime ISA - given the marginal rate now, the expected rate in retirement, growth and years, compared per pound of take-home given up. Use for 'pension or ISA for this £5,000'.

amount.description: Gross amount being decided about, in pounds.

employeeNiPct.description: Employee NI rate on this slice of salary. Defaults to 8.

marginalRateNowPct.description: Marginal income tax rate today, e.g. 40.

retirementRatePct.description: Expected marginal rate when withdrawn, e.g. 20.

taxFreeCashPct.description: Share of the pension taken tax-free. Defaults to 25.

viaSalarySacrifice.description: Paid by salary sacrifice, so employee NI is saved too. Defaults to false.

name: calculate_pension_vs_isa
title: Pension vs ISA (vs Lifetime ISA)
